mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (< 4%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling weakening supply chains, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expected earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in weakening supply chain periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth above 5% YoY, indicating strong retail sales, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as consumer spending drives economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances with RSAFS YoY growth > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (< 3%) and high CPIAUCSL (> 300) creates an inflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek inflation hedges.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of inflationary environment instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp 1-month increase in UNRATE (> 0.5pp), indicating labor market stress, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors reassess economic growth prospects.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 55% of labor market stress instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between HOUST growth above 10% YoY and RSAFS growth above 5% YoY, indicating a strong housing market and consumer spending, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY growth > 10% & RSAFS YoY growth > 5%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances with strong housing and consumer spending, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.04 over any 5-year rolling window.
